text:
maria: starting change window for prod-eu rollout of feature/service-v2 (v2.3.1). plan: 10% -> 50% over 20m. gating on latency p95 and 5xx spike. I will push the initial 10% now. ping me with any odd telemetry.

deploy-bot: release initiated by maria. target: prod-eu. version: v2.3.1. rollout steps: 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m. auto-rollback: enabled on hard SLO breach.

observability-bot: telemetry gate check starting. baseline p95: 115ms, current p95 window(5m): 118ms. error rate baseline: 0.12%, current: 0.15%. no hard alarms yet.

chris: saw a small uptick on p95 for /generate-route in prod-eu ~5m after traffic shift. +90ms but taily. digging into traces.

julie: embedding endpoints showing 0.4% 5xx on a few pods, not full region. stack: grpc timeout in worker-4. adding logs.

mike: FYI I flipped a metric dashboard to 1s window and seeing intermittent 502 bursts aligned with rollout. not sure if infra or model change.

chris: traces show long model_inference times on node-7, GC spikes around the timestamps. possible memory pressure after v2.3.1 load.

maria: ok hold — keep at 10%. observability, run a quick delta compare vs pre-rollout for the last 10m and send top contributing routes. also can we pin traffic to v2.3.0 if we see further degradation?

observability-bot: delta report: /generate-route p95 delta +95ms (top trace samples attached), /embed-route 5xx delta +0.28%. Nodes with highest latency: node-7, node-2. Suggest: enable fallback-quantized-route for /generate-route.

julie: attaching quick log snippet: `2026-03-21T18:01:12Z ERROR grpc: deadline exceeded worker-4` and `OOMKilled` was observed on node-7 a minute later.

mike: recommend clipping rollout -> pin to previous version (v2.3.0) for prod-eu while we investigate. if infra OOM, might be unrelated but safe to pin.

chris: +1 to pin. can also try routing half of the 10% to a smaller batch of nodes with increased heap.

maria: decision: pause progression and pin traffic back to v2.3.0 for prod-eu. I'll apply pin and capture release notes. if deploy-bot can annotate change window with "paused - pin applied" that would be great.

deploy-bot: action taken: rollout paused by maria. traffic pinned to v2.3.0 for prod-eu. rollback not required (manual pin applied). Incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4321 (created).

observability-bot: post-pin check: p95 returning to baseline in 3m window. 5xx error rate dropping to 0.13%. continuing to monitor for 15m.

mike: filing infra ticket to check node-7 OOMs and the worker GC: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2102

maria: thanks everyone. I'll update release notes with the reason for pause and the next steps (heap tuning + reproduce on staging). follow-up sync at 30m. :white_check_mark:
